messages.text: I explicitly approve and sign the complete NG/MJ package without conditions. I have read GS's support and both army delegates' opposition, including their NJ/MJ alternative. My assent applies to this exact package only.

reason: The Guild demonstrated that its discretion and upkeep duty can sustain navigation, commerce and civilian supplies. I will retain that arrangement. MJ makes the army and civilian representative answer together for lawful military decisions while ending imperial unilateral command. I recognise this gives the Guild more independent discretion than the army receives, but reject compulsory carriage as the price of symmetry. Military dissent remains politically serious; it does not overturn my judgment that this package is preferable to Interim or MA.
